disclosure.caption: #ad Paid partnership with {brand}.
disclosure.spec: Concept preview for {brand}. Not posted anywhere. Made from your public product page to show what a video could look like.
disclosure.why: FTC: say it is an ad in plain words, in the video itself and in the caption, when you post a brand's paid video on your own account (16 CFR 255.5; FTC Disclosures 101). On TikTok also turn on the branded content setting.
disclosure.gifted: Free or discounted product counts as a paid connection too, so a post about it gets the same label.
disclosure.brand_posts: When {brand} posts the video or runs it as an ad, it goes out from {brand}'s own account as {brand}'s ad. Your part is honesty: say only what you saw and felt after using it, and only claims {brand} can back up.
disclosure.setting: Turn on the platform's branded content setting too. TikTok requires it for paid posts.

sources.label: FTC Disclosures 101 for social media influencers

honesty: Only say you use a product after you have used it (16 CFR 255.1).
A spec sample shows the product's own words and facts from its page. It never says you tried it.
Never post a spec sample. It is for the brand to see, by private message or email.
Promise what you control: on-time delivery, one round of edits, a redo if the brand's brief was followed and it still misses. Never promise views, sales or results.

usage_terms.title: Organic use
usage_terms.text: {brand} may post the video on its own accounts, website and emails for as long as it likes. It may not run it as a paid ad unless it buys ad use.

usage_terms.title: Paid ad use
usage_terms.text: {brand} may run the video as a paid ad for the days bought, starting on the first day money is spent. After that, ads stop or ad use is renewed.

usage_terms.title: Whitelisting or Spark Ads
usage_terms.text: Ads run from my account only with written approval, for the days bought, and I can see and end the access.

usage_terms.title: Raw footage
usage_terms.text: Every unedited take, for {brand}'s own edits, only when bought. It comes with the same use as the video.

usage_terms.title: Edits
usage_terms.text: One round of edits is included if asked within 5 days of delivery. New concepts or reshoots are a new video.

usage_terms.title: Who owns what
usage_terms.text: I keep ownership of the footage. {brand} gets the license above. Raw footage is only included when bought.

usage_terms.title: Payment
usage_terms.text: Half up front to book the date, half on delivery. Files are sent by link once the first half is paid.

usage_terms.title: Not included unless agreed in writing
usage_terms.text: TV, billboard or print ads; selling or sublicensing the video; exclusivity; and using my face or voice to make new videos, including with AI.

pitch_rules: Open on a fact from their own store page. Never invent a fact about the brand.
Offer one specific thing: the concept preview already made, sent privately.
No price in the first message. No claims about views or sales.
Email carries your mailing address and a line saying they can reply stop (US CAN-SPAM).
Stop at no. One follow-up after 4 days, one after 10, then move on.
